summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K as a foreign private issuer, providing a call notice for an Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM) scheduled for August 28, 2026. The EGM agenda includes the approval of mergers of Juno Participações e Investimentos S.A., Tijo Participações e Investimentos S.A., Retiro Baixo Energética S.A., and SPE Nova Era Janapu Transmissora S.A. into AXIA Energia. The mergers are to be based on book value appraisal reports prepared by Taticca Auditores e Consultores Ltda. and Apsis Consultoria e Avaliações Ltda. This filing is a routine corporate governance notification for shareholder approval of internal reorganizations. No financial terms, premiums, or prices are disclosed. This is not a special situation but a standard EGM call for mergers of related entities. Watch for shareholder approval and regulatory clearance from Brazilian authorities.
